Putative mRNA splicing factor with minimal characterization. Co-clustering with proteasome suggests potential novel link between splicing and protein degradation pathways, similar to SNRPE but with less established function overall.

Well-characterized spliceosomal component with no established connection to proteasome function. Co-clustering is surprising and suggests potential novel crosstalk between splicing machinery and UPS. Could indicate proteasome-mediated regulation of splicing factors or splicing-dependent regulation of proteasome components.

While this function is now established (2021 publication), its co-clustering with proteasome components validates this role and suggests it may have additional undiscovered functions in proteasome regulation or assembly that merit investigation.
